payload.scientific_question: Does sharpening the existing learned logits over the model's legal mark fiber improve ten-prompt superstructure quality without sacrificing diversity, output rate or exact preservation?

supersedes.reason: The candidate-resampling implementation multiplied expensive ring-support enumeration. Its first two attempts ended before any pilot molecule was generated because the isolated worktree lacked the pinned evaluator cache. The direct logit-scale form tests the same learned-prior tilt in one model draw, before any quality outcome was inspected.

payload.baseline: first ten attempts of seed zero in each of the ten frozen official shards; no regenerated control or task-filtered denominator

qualification_gate.interpretation: Directional development screen only. A qualifying candidate still needs the matched de novo screen and full official evaluation.

prohibitions: no change to the completed official superstructure run
no SA or QED in the proposal law
no promotion on fragment fidelity alone
